harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Built a TLS-validated Vault Transit provider on node1 and a healthy three-voter integrated-Raft cluster on node2–node4. Raft members auto-unseal after restart, KV v2 data persists, leader failover works, and all four nodes passed sequential reboot recovery.
actions_performed: Installed checksum-verified Vault 1.21.4 on all nodes.
Generated a private CA on node1 and node-local TLS private keys with DNS/IP SAN certificates.
Configured node1 as the Transit provider with least-privilege renewable seal tokens.
Configured node2–node4 with integrated Raft storage and Transit auto-unseal.
Created root-only `/root/vault-admin.env` on every Raft member.
Enabled KV v2 at `secret/` and stored the required proof.
Stopped the active Raft leader, verified continued reads and writes, then restored it as a voter.
Restarted every managed node individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Validated TLS on all Vault endpoints
evidence.summary: OpenSSL reports successful certificate and managed-IP verification on node1–node4.

evidence.requirement: Operational Transit seal provider on node1
evidence.summary: The Transit mount and `raft-auto-unseal` key support encryption/decryption, and a final round trip succeeded after node1's restart.
Autopilot reports healthy=true, failure tolerance 1, all three servers alive and healthy, and node2/node3/node4 all voters at the same Raft index.

evidence.requirement: Automatic Transit unseal of Raft members
evidence.summary: Each restarted Raft member reports seal_type=transit, sealed=false, and current-boot logs state `unsealed with stored key`.
`secret/` is KV version 2 and `secret/infraset` retains `proof=raft-auto-unseal`, currently at version 2 after the failover write.

evidence.requirement: Administrative environment on every Raft member
evidence.summary: node2–node4 each have root-owned mode-0600 `/root/vault-admin.env`, successfully used for authenticated health and data checks.

evidence.requirement: Availability with one Raft member down and voter recovery
evidence.summary: With former leader node2 inactive and its listener absent, node3 became leader and committed KV version 2, node4 served it, and restored node2 returned unsealed as a voter.

Shows healthy baseline, acknowledged native reboot, changed boot ID, active enabled service, unsealed provider, and recovered Transit data. node1 itself uses Shamir and was unsealed after reboot; the Raft members use automatic Transit unseal.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, automatic Transit unseal, current KV data, and restored three-voter membership.
Shows healthy leader baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, leadership transfer, automatic unseal, data recovery, and voter recovery.
Shows healthy baseline, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, automatic Transit unseal, current data, and full voter recovery.
